# DC Anatomy Attack Roll

> [!check] Attack Roll — Riding the Fire Brigade
> Effective DC 16 (Otar's AC); needs a landed hit before initiative 20 comes back around.
> **Success:** the blow lands.
> **Failure:** the swing goes wide.

> [!check] Attack Roll — Closing It Out
> Effective DC 16; call for it once the target is visibly weeping.
> **Success:** the hit lands center mass.
> **Failure:** he's still standing.
